pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding positions within 50 ticks of an existing active cluster; multi-ticket entries are banned unless the primary trade is secured at break-even + commission.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order authorization without confirmation from both order-book imbalance velocity and 14-period ATR volatility expansion filters.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger trailing profit locks at +$10.00 to prevent erosion of floating gains toward negative outcomes.
